svg.title: The old anchored bound is therefore unchanged after reducing its support exponent by 2ε. If the new Xi lies in the l-halo enlargement of the parent image of Yi, M ≤2B, and the geometric reserve inequality holds, the coarse support estimate applies to v. It allows a new coefficient zi ≤Cwi(1 + covM(Yi))k and pays its new 2ε tariff. Its resulting budget is the explicit footprint payment with fine-child factor L4, extentCost(l, B), degree k, original budget γ, support exponent a and geometric preCost(l). The anchor-to-hit summation and the geometric coarsening proof are given in (NF9)–(NF10) below, with these parameters. For rooted path bundles the same transfer starts from a true length budget P iwi
